newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends low on active dlr buying.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends low on active dlr buying.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed over the Central Bank's selling price on Thursday on dollar buying, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 59.20 to the dollar after opening at 59.10 and falling to a day's low of 59.24, the dealers said.
"The rupee, which began declining when one bank bought cash dollars, was pushed over the Central Bank top when other banks covered short positions," said an ABN Amro Bank dealer.
As the Central Bank left the dollar-rupee exchange rate unchanged on Thursday, buying and selling prices remained at 57.9794 and 59.1507.
"Import covering in the market was met with dollars bought from the Central Bank and did not contribute to the rupee's fall," an American Express Bank dealer said.
Overnight call rates closed at 8.125 percent, with the market well offered, but some dealers cautioned that covering imports with dollars from the Central Bank may tighten money supply.
